# Extra lower-bound constraints for the offline bundle's pip resolver.
#
# These packages are transitive dependencies (not declared in pyproject.toml),
# so they are absent from the auto-generated .constraints.txt. Without lower
# bounds pip backtracks across their entire release history, which blew up as
# "resolution-too-deep" on the boto3 -> jmespath branch of
# snowflake-connector-python during the datus-postgresql stage.
#
# Only add >= lower bounds here. Do NOT use == pins; this file is a resolver
# hint, not a runtime requirement source of truth (pyproject.toml owns that).
# Any entry whose package is already constrained by pyproject.toml is ignored
# by the bundle builder, so pyproject.toml always wins on conflicts.

boto3>=1.34
botocore>=1.34
jmespath>=1.0.1
s3transfer>=0.10
snowflake-connector-python>=3.7
urllib3>=2.0

# Cap the gRPC/protobuf stack so PyPI datus-agent mode stays resolvable:
# datus-agent 0.2.6 on PyPI pulls google-generativeai -> google-ai-generativelanguage 0.6.9,
# which demands protobuf<6. grpcio-status 1.80+ demands protobuf>=6.31, so leave 1.74+.
# grpcio-status 1.73.x lives in the sweet spot (protobuf >=5.26,<6). Cap grpcio alongside
# because grpcio and grpcio-status are released in lockstep and must match versions.
grpcio<1.74
grpcio-status<1.74
protobuf<6
